name: ICC events
notes: The ICC is a governing body, not a league; its commercial partners cover its major events rather than team shirts. Modelled like FIFA: one partner list covering the four senior events in the 2026-27 window.

Premier Partners (top tier): Emirates, Aramco, DP World, Hyundai. Global Partners: Coca-Cola, Budweiser (AB InBev), Google, Sobha Realty, Rexona (Unilever), Marriott Bonvoy. Official supporter: Royal Stag (per https://www.icc-cricket.com/about/partners, fetched 2026-09-25).

Rosters differ slightly per event: the Women's T20 World Cup 2026 footer showed Rexona but not Sobha Realty; the men's-event footers show Sobha Realty. Rexona rides the Unilever women's-cricket deal (women's events only), Sobha Realty is a men's-events-only Global Partner.
ICC's Cricket 4 Good sits in the 'official supporters' footer block but is the ICC's own social-responsibility programme, not a sponsor.

Side note, not researched as a target: the UAE's ILT20 (Emirates Cricket Board) has DP World as title sponsor; franchise owners per Wikipedia (lead only): Reliance, Adani, GMR, Knight Riders, Lancer Capital, Capri Global.
